title: Balanced Grain Bowl
subtitle: with Orange, Avocado and Pistachios
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

steps.text: Roast pumpkin: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Cooking tip). Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper (see Make it faster). Peel the pumpkin and cut into 3cm chunks. Put on the lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast, turning halfway, for 20-25 mins until golden and tender.

Cook freekeh: Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Cook the freekeh, partially covered, for 18-20 mins until tender. Drain, then rinse under cold water to cool.

Make orange vinaigrette: While the pumpkin and freekeh are cooking, juice half the orange, then peel and thinly slice the remaining half. Put the orange juice, half the maple syrup, 1½ tbs olive oil, 1 tbs white wine vinegar and 1 tsp dijon mustard in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine.

Massage kale: Remove the tough inner stems from the kale, then tear the leaves into small pieces. Add the kale to the orange vinaigrette, then massage the vinaigrette into the leaves for 1 min or until the leaves are softened and slightly darkened (massaging helps to break down the tough fibres). Add the freekeh and roast pumpkin to the kale and toss to combine.
Serve up: Thinly slice the avocado. Coarsely chop the pistachios. Divide the freekeh salad among bowls, then top with the sliced orange, avocado and pistachios. Enjoy!
Make it faster: If you have an air fryer, use it to cook the pumpkin instead – there’s no need to turn the oven on or line a baking tray!
